headline: ABVP Sweeps Goa University Student Council Elections
summary: The Akhil Bharatiya Vidyarthi Parishad (ABVP) won all nine seats in the Goa University Students' Council elections. The rival NSUI failed to win any posts.

headline: 9-Day IFFI Concludes in Goa
summary: The 55th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) came to a close in Goa following nine days of film screenings and cultural events.

headline: Academy Official Highlights High Cost of Oscar Submissions
summary: Speaking at IFFI in Goa, an Academy official noted that submission and promotional fees for the Oscars can be prohibitively expensive for filmmakers.

headline: Film 'Skylark' Premieres at IFFI Focusing on Border Divisions
summary: The feature film 'Skylark' was showcased at IFFI in Goa, bringing attention to the emotional and human cost of divided international borders.

headline: Supreme Court Halts HoABL's Karapur Township Project
summary: The Supreme Court has issued a temporary stay on construction, technical clearances, and permissions for HoABL's proposed township project in Karapur.

headline: Goa Government Notifies Rules for Increased FAR and Building Heights
summary: The Goa government has introduced a new framework allowing floor area ratio (FAR) up to 300 and building heights up to 40 metres. The policy also offers regularization for previously approved FAR.

headline: NGO Prepares to Challenge 1,639 Approved Building Clearances
summary: A local NGO in Goa has announced plans to legally challenge 1,639 floor area ratio (FAR) clearances issued by authorities.

headline: Goa Tourism Sector Prepares for Slower Winter Season
summary: Hoteliers and local businesses across Goa are anticipating lower tourist footfall and quieter beaches during the upcoming winter season.

headline: Spain Finalizes India Co-Production Deal at IFFI
summary: Spain is close to signing a film co-production pact with India as it concludes its stint as the 'Country of Honor' at IFFI and the WAVES Film Bazaar.

headline: Second Volume of 'Churches of Goa' Book Released
summary: The Auxiliary Bishop has officially released the second volume of 'Churches of Goa', which documents the state's historical and architectural religious heritage.

headline: Anil Ravipudi Announces Animated 'Ramayana' Film at IFFI
summary: Filmmaker Anil Ravipudi announced his upcoming animated feature film based on the Ramayana during an event at IFFI in Goa, calling it his dream project.

headline: British Tourists Share Emotional Farewell to Goa
summary: A visiting British couple expressed sadness at concluding their week-long trip, calling Goa a unique and memorable holiday destination.

headline: Goa Ranked Among India's Top Christmas Destinations
summary: Goa has been listed among the top eight locations in India to celebrate Christmas, highlighting its festive traditions and events.

headline: Flying Flea C6 Electric Bike Enters Goa Market
summary: The Flying Flea C6 electric motorcycle has officially expanded its commercial presence into Goa.

headline: MLA Reginaldo Urges Help for Goans Detained in US
summary: Curtorim MLA Aleixo Reginaldo Lourenco has requested central government intervention to expedite travel documents for Goan citizens currently detained in the United States.

headline: Goa Resident Duped of ₹2.4 Lakh in Mobile Home Fraud
summary: A Goa resident recovering from surgery paid ₹2.4 lakh for a mobile home to house caregivers, only to discover the provider failed to deliver the unit.

headline: Illegal Quarrying Causes Environmental Damage in Sattari
summary: Unrestricted illegal laterite quarrying has damaged landscapes and stripped green cover in parts of Sattari.

headline: Goa to Digitise Portuguese-Era Administrative Records
summary: Historical manuscripts documenting Goa's administrative and legal history during the Portuguese era are set to be digitized for preservation.

headline: High Court Orders Compensation for Birch Fire Victims
summary: The High Court has directed authorities to release the first installment of financial compensation to families affected by the Birch fire incident.

headline: Goan Tour Operator Honoured in Israel on 100th Trip
summary: A tour organizer from Goa was recognized in Israel upon completing his 100th group pilgrimage tour to the Holy Land.

headline: NCC Cadets Flag Off 220-km Maritime Expedition
summary: National Cadet Corps (NCC) cadets have started a 220-kilometer coastal sailing expedition covering the stretch between Karwar and Goa.

headline: Goa Govt to Introduce Bill Regulating Comunidade Staff
summary: The state government plans to table a new bill aimed at regulating the service conditions and rules for employees working in local comunidades.

headline: Salcete Farmers Warn New Auction Rules Threaten Khazans
summary: Agricultural tenants in Salcete expressed concern that new auction guidelines could harm traditional khazan farming systems.

headline: AAP Launches Anti-Inflation Campaign in Goa
summary: The Aam Aadmi Party has launched its 'Mhargai Mukti Yatra' in Goa, promising financial relief packages worth ₹15,000 per family if voted to power.

headline: Centre Defends Goa ST Reservation Law in High Court
summary: The Central government informed the High Court that Goa's Scheduled Tribe reservation law is constitutional and legally valid.

headline: Relocated Goa Elephant 'Omkar' Joins Wild Herd in Maharashtra
summary: An elephant named Omkar, relocated from Goa, has successfully integrated into a female-led wild elephant herd in Maharashtra.

headline: CM Urges Strict Implementation of POSH Committees at Workplaces
summary: Goa Chief Minister has called on all organizations to strictly establish Prevention of Sexual Harassment (POSH) committees to ensure workplace safety.

headline: Spring Tide Inundates Low-Lying Areas in Mala
summary: High water levels caused by a spring tide led to coastal overflow and waterlogging in several parts of Mala.

headline: GHRDC Announces Housing Loan Scheme for Employees
summary: The Goa Human Resource Development Corporation (GHRDC) has launched a specialized home building loan scheme for its staff.

headline: Porvorim Flyover Ramps Set to Open Within 15 Days
summary: All entry and exit ramps connected to the Porvorim flyover will be opened for public traffic within the next two weeks.

headline: Goan Prelate Steps Down as Bishop of Daltonganj
summary: A senior Goan clergyman has officially resigned from his post as the Bishop of the Daltonganj diocese.

headline: Unsafe Vasco Structure Marked for Demolition
summary: Authorities in Vasco have slated a dilapidated, structurally unsafe building for complete demolition and reconstruction.

headline: Unseasonal Rains Damage Arecanut Harvest in Sattari
summary: Unexpected heavy rainfall in Sattari soaked harvested arecanuts laid out to dry, leaving local farmers facing crop losses.

headline: Debate Held on Data Collection and Constitutional Protections
summary: Legal experts and analysts in Goa held discussions regarding the intersection of government statistics and constitutional safeguards.

headline: Goan Community in Aberdeen Celebrates Diwali
summary: Members of the Goan diaspora living in Aberdeen, Scotland, gathered to celebrate Diwali with traditional festivities.

headline: Congress Warns of Potential Outsider Voter Influx
summary: The Goa Congress party has cautioned election officials against the illegal inclusion of non-resident voters in the state electoral rolls.

headline: South Goa Earns 'Saksham District' Status for HIV Prevention
summary: South Goa has been awarded 'Saksham District' status after meeting key performance targets in HIV control and awareness programs.
